newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Nov natgas prices rally on storage - NGC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Nov natgas prices rally on storage - NGC.

text.p: U.S. spot natural gas prices for November jumped sharply from October levels, driven primarily by increased demand for storage injections, Natural Gas Clearinghouse (NGC) said Thursday.
U.S. spot gas prices for November averaged $2.61 per million British thermal units, up 88 cents on the month and 95 cents over last year's average.

Prices into Columbia Gas rose 85 cents on the month to $2.65 and held a 90-cent premium to last year, NGC said in its monthly survey. Most Gulf pipes gained 85-90 cents for the month and jumped to about 90 cents above year-ago.
